name: ARMBench
description: ARMBench is a large-scale benchmark for robotic manipulation in warehouse settings, designed to evaluate object-centric perception and manipulation under clutter, inventory variation, and changing real-world conditions.
evaluation_method: Task success rate and related manipulation metrics such as grasp success, pick success, retrieval accuracy, and completion rate in warehouse-like scenarios.
typical_sota_score: 70–95% depending on task and reported metric (task success / grasp success / completion rate)
notes: Targets real warehouse manipulation challenges including clutter, object diversity, and dynamic inventory. Exact benchmark protocol may combine perception and control components.
